``` {r eval = FALSE}
# --- load clim4health package --- #
library(clim4health)

# --- specify personal access token for CDS API --- #
pat_api <- "XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"

# --- specify path to save the data --- #
data_path <- "/path/to/outdir/"
outname <- paste0("era5land_", var)
path_era  <- paste0(data_path, "/Colombia/era5land/")

# --- specify variables and month to download --- #
longname <- "total_precipitation"
month <- 12

for (i in 1981:2016) {
  if (!file.exists(paste0(path_era, outname, "_",
                          i, sprintf("%02d", month), ".nc"))) {
    c4h_get(pat = pat_api,
            dataset = "reanalysis-era5-land-monthly-means",
            product_type = "monthly_averaged_reanalysis",
            variable = longname,          # use longname variable
            year = i,                     # year to download
            month = month,                # month to download
            bbox = c(5.5, -78, 3.0, -75), # bounding box
            outname = outname,            # output file name prefix
            outpath = path_era)           # output path
  }
}
```
